performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

task 14374 (small_fix) — issue #8036 / PR #8494 — lane tmp-code-y, 2026-11-11

State advanced past the last checkpoint: the prior uncommitted implementation was committed as 0ae5e39a8da77b1579c8598e2b5789d6a9d1ae00 on branch queue/14374-8036-joined-frames and PR #8494 is OPEN. Re-verified fresh this shift: issue #8036 OPEN, no hard-stop labels, no status/needs-triage; PR head matches the Codex-reviewed commit. CI rollup: 11 QUEUED, 1 SUCCESS, 1 SKIPPED, 1 NEUTRAL.

Codex gate (§5) — BLOCKS MERGE: the Codex review on commit 0ae5e39 completed with has_any_findings=true, has_unresolved_findings=true. Three P2 findings, all read as valid on inspection:

1. pkgs/id/contract/shell-contract.v1.json (conformance, src/shell_contract.rs): Conformance::client stays in Phase::Joined after a joined install_begin — it only applies a frame's opens transition in Phase::Opening — so install_chunk/install_end are rejected and check_contract rejects transcripts from the new flow. Fix: enter the upload phase from a joined session and return to joined (not closed) when the upload ends.
2. pkgs/id/src/world_session/mod.rs:823: WorldHandle::install_program_authorized hardcodes trust: None, so the durable ProgramInstalled event journals neither SignatureVerified nor the publisher key for a trusted-publisher builder install. Fix: derive the same TrustDecision as the admin upload path and carry it through the capability-authorized install command.
3. pkgs/id/src/world_session/mod.rs:826: authorization denials returned by install_program_authorized / revoke_authorized themselves are mapped to Unavailable / an uncoded "revoke failed", losing the stable actor_denied wire code when the capability expires or a queued revocation lands between the preliminary authorize and the operation. Fix: classify authorization failures from the operation commands, not only the preliminary check.

Terminal for this shift: task 14374 parked. Resume: fix all three findings on branch queue/14374-8036-joined-frames (worktree /home/user/git/fleet/queue-14374-8036-joined-frames), run the pkgs/id cargo tests, push, disposition each Codex thread on PR #8494, then merge on green CI and complete task 14374 / close issue #8036.
